! Network rule corpus for parity testing against @adguard/tsurlfilter.
! Each non-comment, non-empty line is a valid network rule that both packages must parse identically.
! Covers all modifier groups: basic flags, domain, to, denyallow, method, header,
! resource types, advanced modifiers, allowlist, priority categories, and badfilter.

! === Basic rules (no modifiers) ===
||example.com^
||ads.example.org^
/banner/
||cdn.example.com/assets/ad.js

! === Simple flag modifiers ===
||example.com^$third-party
||example.com^$~third-party
||example.com^$match-case
||example.com^$~match-case
||example.com^$important
||example.com^$third-party,important

! === $domain modifier ===
||example.com^$domain=foo.com
||example.com^$domain=foo.com|bar.com
||example.com^$domain=~baz.com
||example.com^$domain=foo.com|~bar.com
||example.com^$domain=one.com|two.com|~three.com

! === $to modifier ===
||example.com^$to=target.com
||example.com^$to=a.com|b.com
||example.com^$to=~excluded.com

! === $denyallow modifier ===
||example.com^$denyallow=safe.com
||example.com^$denyallow=safe.com|also-safe.com

! === $method modifier ===
||example.com^$method=get
||example.com^$method=get|post
||example.com^$method=~head

! === Resource type modifiers ===
||example.com^$script
||example.com^$stylesheet
||example.com^$image
||example.com^$media
||example.com^$font
||example.com^$xmlhttprequest
||example.com^$websocket
||example.com^$subdocument
||example.com^$ping
||example.com^$other
||example.com^$object
||example.com^$script,image
||example.com^$~script
||example.com^$~image,~media

! === $header modifier ===
||example.com^$header=set-cookie
||example.com^$header=x-custom-header:value

! === Allowlist rules ===
@@||example.com^
@@||example.com^$document
@@||example.com^$elemhide
@@||example.com^$generichide
@@||example.com^$specifichide
@@||example.com^$elemhide,content,urlblock,jsinject
@@||example.com^$important
@@||example.com^$domain=foo.com
@@||example.com^$third-party

! === $csp modifier ===
||example.com^$csp=default-src 'self'
||example.com^$csp=script-src 'none'

! === $redirect modifier ===
||example.com^$redirect=noopjs
||example.com^$redirect=1x1-transparent.gif
||example.com^$image,redirect=1x1-transparent.gif

! === $removeparam modifier ===
||example.com^$removeparam=utm_source
||example.com^$removeparam=fbclid
||example.com^$removeparam

! === $removeheader modifier ===
||example.com^$removeheader=refresh
||example.com^$removeheader=location

! === $cookie modifier ===
||example.com^$cookie

! === $permissions modifier ===
||example.com^$permissions=camera=()

! === $badfilter ===
||example.com^$badfilter
||example.com^$third-party,badfilter
||example.com^$domain=foo.com,badfilter

! === Combined modifiers ===
||example.com^$third-party,domain=foo.com
||example.com^$script,third-party,domain=test.com
||example.com^$important,third-party,match-case
||example.com^$image,domain=site.com|~sub.site.com,third-party
||example.com^$script,domain=example.org,to=target.com
||example.com^$method=get,domain=foo.com
||ads.example.com^$third-party,denyallow=safe.com,domain=publisher.com

! === Regex rules ===
/banner\d+\.js/
/ads\.(js|css)/$script

! === Priority edge cases ===
||example.com^$domain=a.com|b.com|c.com|d.com|e.com
||example.com^$script,image,stylesheet,media
@@||example.com^$important,domain=foo.com
||example.com^$redirect=noopjs,important

! === Noop modifier ===
||example.com^$_,script
||example.com^$___,important

! === $first-party alias ===
||example.com^$first-party

! === $document and $doc aliases ===
@@||example.com^$document
